prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Educational cooperative play story atlas ages6-8. EXACTLY TWO columns FOUR rows, eight equal edge-to-edge frames, no gutters or borders. Any adult woman wears hijab. Row-major panel1 problem situation; panel2 calm discussion of both needs; panel3 respectful open-palm request; panel4 compare concrete alternatives; panel5 exactly alternative A; panel6 exactly alternative B; panel7 try an agreement; panel8 review together.
